title: Lifesteal SP
description: This project adds Singleplayer Mechanics to simulate the Lifesteal SMP feel.
body: # Lifesteal SP A singleplayer take on the Lifesteal SMP format. Every death costs you a heart. Gain them back by crafting the **Enchanted Totem**. Run out of hearts and it's over. --- ## How it works ### Losing hearts Every time you die, your maximum health is permanently reduced by one heart. You start with 10 hearts and the floor is zero. ### Game over When your last heart is gone, the world locks. You'll see a game over screen and the world won't be continuable. It's still accessible from the main menu so you can look back at your journey, but you can't play on. ### Gaining hearts back Craft an **Enchanted Totem** and right-click it to gain one heart permanently. Hearts are capped at 10 by default (configurable). Crafting one isn't easy: | Ingredient | Amount | |---|---| | Enchanted Golden Apple | 8 | | Totem of Undying | 1 | That's 8 notch apples! --- ## Configuration On first launch a `lifesteal_sp.json` config file is generated in your config folder. Available options: ```json { "max_hearts": 10 } ``` `max_hearts` controls the cap on how many hearts you can hold. Default is 10. Set it higher if you want to stack multiple Enchanted Totems beyond the vanilla maximum. --- ## Compatibility - ✅ Server-side only — no client mod required - ✅ Fabric, Minecraft 26.1.2 --- ## FAQ **Is this actual hardcore?** No. The world doesn't delete and you respawn normally until your hearts hit zero. It's a middle ground between normal and hardcore — mistakes have lasting consequences without a single bad death ending everything. **Can I recover from 1 heart?** Yes, but you'll need to survive long enough to hunt 8 notch apples, which is its own challenge at 1 heart. **What happens to hearts above the max if I lower the config?** Your current health won't be reduced retroactively — the cap only applies to gaining new hearts via the Enchanted Totem. ---
